# property-testing-names

Person-name arbitraries (`en`, `ru`) for `rasuvaeff/property-testing-core`.
Namespace: `Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Names`.

Install:

```
composer require --dev rasuvaeff/property-testing-names
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3–8.5, `ext-mbstring`, core `^0.9 || ^0.10 || ^0.11`.
- There is **no** `Gen::name()`. The entry point is the `Names::` facade; core
  keeps only format-derived generators (`Gen::email()`, `Gen::uuid()`, …).
- Registered locales: `en`, `ru`. Anything else — including `'EN'`, `'en-US'`,
  `'en '` — throws `InvalidArgumentException` when the arbitrary is built.
- Middle names (patronymics) exist for `ru` only. `Names::middle('en')`,
  `Names::person(middle: true)` and `Names::full(middle: true)` on `en` throw
  `InvalidArgumentException: Locale "en" has no middle-name (patronymic) dataset`.
- `Names::first()` and `Names::last()` are independent draws and do not agree on
  gender. Use `Names::person()` when the parts must agree (`ru` inflects
  surnames and patronymics).
- Values shrink toward the earliest (shortest) dataset entries.
- Data is synthetic; dataset changes ship as minor releases because they change
  what a given seed produces.
- Regression corpus: a counterexample whose argument is a `PersonName` is stored
  as a *seed* entry (the core codec encodes no objects but enums), and a dataset
  minor makes that seed replay a different person. String arguments
  (`Names::full()`/`first()`/`last()`) are stored as *values* and replay through
  any release — use them when the corpus must survive upgrades.
  `CounterExample::toExamplesCode()` throws on a `PersonName` argument.
- `Gen::forClass(PersonName::class)` does not use the datasets: it builds parts
  from the constructor's `non-empty-string` annotations (arbitrary text, including
  whitespace-only strings the constructor refuses). For a class that holds a
  `PersonName`, pass `Names::person()` as the override:
  `Gen::forClass(Profile::class, ['name' => Names::person('ru')])`.
- `Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Names\Internal\*` is `@internal`: no custom
  datasets, no runtime locale registration.

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Gen;
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Names\Gender;
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Names\Names;
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Names\PersonName;

// ArbitraryInterface<non-empty-string>
Names::first(string $locale = 'en', ?Gender $gender = null);
Names::last(string $locale = 'en', ?Gender $gender = null);
Names::middle(string $locale, ?Gender $gender = null);          // locale required
Names::full(string $locale = 'en', ?Gender $gender = null, bool $middle = false);

// ArbitraryInterface<PersonName>
Names::person(string $locale = 'en', ?Gender $gender = null, bool $middle = false);
Names::locales();  // non-empty-list<non-empty-string>, the registered codes -- NOT an arbitrary

Names::DEFAULT_LOCALE;   // 'en'
Gender::Male; Gender::Female;   // string-backed: 'male', 'female'; declaration order = shrink order
```

`PersonName` (`final readonly`, `Stringable`): `$first`, `?$middle`, `$last`, `$gender`.

```php
$p = new PersonName('Иван', 'Иванович', 'Иванов', Gender::Male);
$p->full();          // 'Иван Иванович Иванов'   (en: 'John Smith')
(string) $p;         // same as full()
$p->initialLast();   // 'И. Иванов'              (en: 'J. Smith')
$p->lastInitials();  // 'Иванов И. И.'           (en: 'Smith J.')
json_encode($p);     // {"first":"Иван","middle":"Иванович","last":"Иванов","gender":"male"}
```

The constructor throws `InvalidArgumentException` on a `$first`/`$middle`/`$last`
that is empty or whitespace-only, naming the part (`First name must not be
empty`, `Middle name …`, `Last name …`); use `null` for "no middle name".

## Use in a property test (Testo)

```php
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\ArbitraryInterface;
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Names\Gender;
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Names\Names;
use Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Property;
use Testo\Assert;

#[Property(runs: 300)]
public function displayNameFitsTheColumn(string $first, string $last): void
{
    Assert::true(mb_strlen((new Profile($first, $last))->displayName()) <= 255);
}

/** @return array<string, ArbitraryInterface> */
public static function displayNameFitsTheColumnGenerators(): array
{
    return [
        'first' => Names::first('ru', Gender::Female),
        'last' => Names::last('ru', Gender::Female),
    ];
}
```

## Composition with core generators

```php
// Address derived from a given name.
Gen::map(
    Gen::tuple(Names::first('en'), Gen::elements(['@example.com', '@example.org'])),
    static fn (array $p): string => mb_strtolower((string) $p[0]) . (string) $p[1],
);

// A display form the value object does not provide.
Gen::map(Names::person('ru'), static fn (PersonName $p): string => $p->last . ', ' . $p->first);

// Optional names, collections of names.
Gen::nullable(Names::last('ru'));
Gen::arrayOf(Names::full('en'));
```

## Eager sampling (debugging only)

```php
Gen::sample(Names::full('ru', middle: true), 3, 6);   // fixed seed → reproducible
Gen::sampleShrinks(Names::person('ru'), 11);          // value + first shrink candidates
```
